title: Big bands with Chuck and Chuckles and the Gotham Circuit
summary: Green lists bands including Casa Loma, Sissle, Moten, Henderson and Redman, and explains the Gotham Circuit of movie theatres where bands and dancers appeared as features.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: What big bands did you appear with
Well, Glen Gray's Casa Lomas (sic) and Noble Sissle and the Aces, Bennie Moten, Fletcher Henderson, the Jazz Giants which was Don Redman.
Were you appearing as a single or were you appearing with Chuckles?
And were you the only dancers that were on the bill? Or were other dancers traveling with you? Was it a troupe?
Yes, it was a troupe, that's right. It was circuit, see. That's what it was. It was the Gotham Circuit they called it -- the Gotham Circuit.
Well, it was a series of theaters, you know, like the Gotham, the Hippodrome, Cicero -- what was the other one -- Monarch.

Well, they were in different parts of the country. The Gotham was here in New York City, you see, but they changed the name of the theater -- it became another name -- it became Pithias or something like that. It was out there on Broadway up in the west, you know -- Gotham.
So, you and Chuckles would travel --
-- as the dancers. Were you the only dancers, though, that were part of the group with the big bands?
No, no, no. They had several dancing acts, you know.
Were you the only ones that would be traveling with one particular band at one time?
Did each band have their own set of dancers, or did the band have a lot of dancers? Did the band bring in a whole show, or did the band just have the music and --

It was called features -- you know, like featuring -- you see. The word feature -- because the bands was appearing in movie theaters, see. They showed moving pictures -- films -- see. That was in the days of "The March of Time," which was an important film about the world -- a documentary. It was all around the world, you see. And, as I said, now, Slim and Shorty had a show-stopping act, see, but it was just tap dancing. But we were Chuck and Chuckles and it continued, see. We had improved. In other words, we were out of the apprenticeship into, you see, personalities, which was a standard act -- featured attraction ting like this.
